title: Elizondo met Edward Teller on an Air Florida flight
summary: Lou Elizondo tells of Elizondo met Edward Teller on an Air Florida flight, about when Elizondo was about seven at Air Florida flight, Sarasota to Miami, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Air Florida flight, Sarasota to Miami

tellings.quote: when I was a kid I was about seven years old on a air Florida uh flight my father uh had some friends in the government and he uh put me on a plane with him

plain: Lou Elizondo, a former US defense intelligence official, says that when he was about seven his father, who had friends in government, put him on an Air Florida flight from Sarasota to Miami. He says he sat with Edward Teller, the physicist behind the hydrogen bomb. He tells it as an early brush with the world of secret science he would later join.
